title: Evening Primrose Oil for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Evening Primrose Oil for Hair: Evidence & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What a skin trial and a Cochrane review show about evening primrose oil, why there is no evidence for hair, and the pregnancy and blood-thinner cautions.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) claimed hair benefits. Removed; rewritten around skin and safety research.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No hair study exists; evidence too thin for a standard refresh. You may prefer to hold or merge it.
